headline: no visible function has this dot-call name
reason: The library has no len or length: a list's length is list.size, and a text's is text.char_count or text.byte_count (reference 3.4).

headline: case doesn't cover every possible value; missing: (Fahrenheit, Fahrenheit)
reason: The arms must cover every possible value (reference 7.2).

headline: arithmetic is used on a type without Number
reason: Text has no Number, so + doesn't join texts; insert them into one text instead, as in "#{a}#{b}" (reference 3.4).

primary.label: expected Int or BigInt or Decimal or Float, found Text

headline: a visible name is bound again
reason: While a name is visible it can't be bound again; to assign it again, declare it with var where it is first bound (reference 6.2).

primary.label: this name already has a meaning

secondary.label: the other meaning of this name
